      How customer reviews and ratings work

      Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

      To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

      • Shabrica Wadley
        5 out of 5 stars
        Expensive but worth it
        Reviewed in the United States on May 24, 2026
        Style: ConsoleColor: Black
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        I purchased this Switch for my godson, and so far he absolutely loves it! He has been extremely happy with it, and up to this point we haven’t had any issues with the system itself. It’s been a great gift and definitely worth seeing how excited he was when he finally got it.

        I will say, I initially had a problem with the delivery. At the time, I was living in the Philippines and had the package shipped to my grandma’s house in the U.S. A package arrived, but it was not the Switch. Instead, it was just a small envelope with nothing in it, which was honestly stressful considering how expensive these systems are.

        Thankfully, customer service completely rectified the situation and immediately sent out another one. Because they handled the issue quickly and made it right, I’m giving 5 stars. With the price of these consoles, replacing it without a hassle meant a lot and I’m very thankful for that.

        Honestly, after seeing how much he loved it and how fun the system looked, I ended up purchasing myself a Switch 2. 😂

        A great feature that I love about this system is the multiplayer capabilities and connecting it to your TV or PC.

        The battery life seems to be pretty decent. So far, we have no complaints.
